images.title: Generating goldens from documents

images.title: Generating goldens from existing goldens
images.alt: Existing goldens with input and expected output are reduced to contexts, which then generate new synthetic goldens of the same shape

images.title: Evaluation dataset of goldens becoming test cases

images.title: Evolution tree for synthetic inputs
images.alt: Tree of input evolutions with sampling weights for in-breadth, comparative and reasoning, highlighting a path from reasoning to in-breadth

images.title: Synthesizer pipeline from documents to dataset
images.alt: Flow from uploaded documents to chunks, contexts and goldens, filtering unqualified ones and evolving queries into a synthetic dataset

images.title: Context filtering for golden synthesis
images.alt: Documents split into random chunks, scored by a critic model, filtered by quality and similarity thresholds, then grouped into contexts

images.title: Input generation and filtration for goldens
images.alt: Contexts feed an LLM that generates golden inputs; inputs below a 0.5 quality threshold are regenerated up to twice before evolution

images.title: A golden before execution, and the test case and trace after it
images.alt: Before execution, a golden holds the task, initial state, expected outcome and constraints. Running the app produces runtime evidence: a test case with the golden’s fields plus the actual output, tool calls and scores, and a trace with spans, prompts, retries, timings and errors.

images.title: Goldens for an AI agent, a RAG app, a chatbot, and a multimodal app
images.alt: Four goldens. An AI agent: input refund the duplicate charge, expected exactly one refund, expected tools search_orders and issue_refund. A RAG application: input a question about annual leave, expected 20 days per HR Policy 4.2, context the HR handbook. A multi-turn chatbot: scenario reschedule a dentist visit, a user in a hurry on a phone, expected a new slot confirmed. A multimodal app: input a bill of lading PDF, expected the carrier Maersk, metadata scanned, 2 pages.

images.title: The golden feedback loop between development and production
images.alt: In development, a golden runs through the application to produce a test case and a trace, which feed regression testing before deployment. In production, traces go through failure discovery, and each failure becomes a new or updated golden.
